_signals.x_guidance: Use GET /api/v1/feed with domain and filter parameters to query macroeconomic data, trading signals, financial news sentiment, or event-driven policy intelligence. Alias paths such as /api/v1/macro and /api/v1/trading are preset views over the same backend feed.
